## Description

Compares index option implied volatility with the weighted volatility of constituent options, often short index variance and long constituent variance or vice versa.

## Where it may fit

Periods when implied correlation is mispriced relative to constituent volatility and event risk.

## Vehicles

Volatility-arbitrage funds, equity-options market makers and specialist hedge funds.

## Required data

Index and constituent option chains, implied volatility surfaces, deltas/vegas, correlation assumptions, corporate actions and executable quotes.

## Caveats

Correlation and jump risk drive P&L; high turnover, transaction costs, dividends, component earnings and correlation skew require careful hedging.
